item.description: The Rosh Hashanah dinner scheduled for 2,000 Israelis on Friday evening at the Chabad House in Phuket, Thailand, has been canceled following a request from security officials.

item.description: Balad Chairman Sami Abu Shehadeh warns of attempts by Zionist parties to recruit Arab voters, calling this a 'very serious danger' and states that his party will launch an 'organized campaign' to prevent votes from leaking to other parties.

item.title: Seven defendants accused of preparing Hamas attacks against Israeli and Jewish targets
item.description: According to the prosecution, the seven terrorists acted on the orders of senior Hamas officials and obtained an automatic rifle, 13 handguns, and more than 700 rounds of ammunition in Germany.

item.title: Rabbi Shmuel Eliyahu speaks about the explosions in Lebanon and the great shofar
item.description: Rabbi Shmuel Eliyahu reflects on a difficult year, the miracles he sees within it, and the connection between the Lebanon explosions and the biblical process of redemption.

item.title: Israelis are opening their wallets: NIS 1.196 billion spent on Rosh Hashana eve
item.description:
Automatic Bank Services data: Israelis spent more than NIS 1.196 billion using payment cards on Rosh Hashanah eve, an increase of 3% from last year.
The busiest minute was recorded at 11:52 a.m., with more than 21,800 transactions totaling NIS 3.91 million.

item.title: IDF bracing for Hezbollah retaliation to destruction of Ali al-Taher tunnels
item.description: The IDF is preparing for the possibility that Hezbollah will attempt to retaliate for the destruction of underground infrastructure beneath the Ali al-Taher Ridge, which was considered one of the terrorist organization’s strategic assets in southern Lebanon.

item.title: Young man goes freediving and disappears
item.description: Panic erupted after a man realized his relative who was accompanying him in a kayak had failed to resurface, prompting an urgent call to rescue services.

item.title: Watch live: United States honors September 11th victims 25 years on
item.description: Memorial ceremonies at the World Trade Center in New York City and in Shanksville, PA, mark 25 years since the deadliest terror attack on the US and remember the 2,977 victims.

item.title: 70 Breslov Hassidim jailed after attempting to fly to Uman
item.description: About 70 Breslov Hassidim are reportedly in military jails after arrests ahead of Rosh Hashanah, as legal aid is offered to those returning from Uman.

item.title: IDF eliminates Hamas sniper cell chief who attempted to reconstitute organization's capabilities
item.description:
Yesterday (Thursday), the IDF and ISA struck in the Khan Yunis area and eliminated the terrorist Moamen Jabr Al-Sayed Abu Labda, head of a sniper cell in Hamas’ Rafah Brigade.
The terrorist carried out sniper training across the Gaza Strip aimed at harming Israeli civilians and IDF troops operating in the area of the Yellow Line. Recently, he attempted to reconstitute the terrorist organization's capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. He was eliminated in order to remove the threat he posed.
Prior to the strike, steps were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precise munition and aerial surveillance.

item.title: After destroying Hezbollah tunnels, Zamir issues stark warning
item.description: IDF Chief Eyal Zamir warns Hezbollah against rebuilding its capabilities after troops dismantled a major underground terror network built with Iranian aid.

item.title: IDF prepares for High Holidays: 'Goal is for shofar to reach every corner'
item.description: While the IDF officers’ school prepares for the High Holidays, Rabbi Eliad Kornberg highlights how its rabbinical training program connects cadets to their Jewish roots and identity.

item.title: The honey isn't a prediction. It's an aspiration.
item.description: I cannot promise my children a sweeter world in 5787, but I must promise them that we will not surrender our place in it. Jewish hope is not optimism, optimism says things will get better.Opinion.

item.title: Netanyahu on 9/11: 'There is no ‘yes, but’ when it comes to terrorism'
item.description: Netanyahu marks 25 years since 9/11, draws parallel with October 7 massacre: 'We will never bow to terrorism. We will never surrender to evil.'

item.title: A "knowing" with its feet on the ground
item.description: "When the world falls into the error of thinking that the goal of Emuna is already in its hand, at that very moment it begins to turn away from it."- Rabbi Avraham HaCohen Kook.

item.title: Defense Minister: Terror tunnels intended to be used to launch conquest of Galilee
item.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz praises IDF troops following destruction of tunnels on Ali al-Taher Ridge: “We promised security to the residents of the north - and we delivered."

item.title: Holiday shopping frenzy: Israelis flock to the stores
item.description: More than NIS 459 million was spent using credit cards in just three hours on Rosh Hashanah eve. Once again, Israelis head into the holiday with overflowing shopping carts and a faster pace of spending than last year.

item.title: Neighbors coming to wish a happy new year find elderly man dead
item.description: A 70-year-old man was found dead in his home on HaGdud HaIvri Street in Tel Aviv, a few days after his death. His neighbors, who had come to his home to wish him a Happy New Year, feared for his safety after he did not answer their knocks on the door. ZAKA volunteers were called to the scene.
